baselineDisplay.title: Is This Your Shirt
baselineDisplay.question: Whose shirt is white?
baselineDisplay.text:
Whose shirt is white?

Whose shirt is that?
Is this your shirt Dave?
No. Sir.
It's not my shirt.
This is my shirt.
My shirt's blue.
Is this shirt Tim's?
Perhaps it is sir.
Tim's shirt's white.
Tim!
Yes sir?
Is this your shirt?
Yes sir.
Here you are.
Catch!
Thank you sir.
baselineDisplay.bodyText:
Whose shirt is that?
Is this your shirt Dave?
No. Sir.
It's not my shirt.
This is my shirt.
My shirt's blue.
Is this shirt Tim's?
Perhaps it is sir.
Tim's shirt's white.
Tim!
Yes sir?
Is this your shirt?
Yes sir.
Here you are.
Catch!
Thank you sir.
baselineDisplay.bodyTextZh:
那是谁的衬衫？
这是你的衬衫吗，戴夫？
不，先生。
这不是我的衬衫。
这是我的衬衫。
我的衬衫是蓝色的。
这是蒂姆的衬衫吗？
也许是的，先生。
蒂姆的衬衫是白色的。
蒂姆！
先生，什么事？
这是你的衬衫吗？
是的，先生。
给你。
接住！
谢谢您，先生。
